title: The US yield curve slope as a signal for spot gold over the next weeks

rule.slope: 4-week change of (long yield - 2-year yield), yields proxied by -ln(price change) / duration ({"usb02y":1.9,"usb10y":8,"usb30y":17}); z vs the 156 earlier weekly values
rule.sides: z > 1 long gold, z < -1 short gold
rule.entry: next gold open after the signal week
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long on longs

tests.what: 2s30s 4-week slope change z > +1: long gold, z < -1: short gold, 20 gold candles (primary)
2s10s 4-week slope change, same rule, 20 gold candles
2s30s 4-week slope change, same rule, 5 gold candles
